meta.name: firecrawl
meta.description: Search, scrape, and interact with the web via the Firecrawl CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up online, scrape a webpage, grab content from a URL, get data from a website, crawl documentation, download a site, or interact with pages that need clicks or logins. Also use when they say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", "get the page at https://", or reference external websites. This provides real-time web search with full page content and interact capabilities — beyond what Claude can do natively with built-in tools. Do NOT trigger for local file operations, git commands, deployments, or code editing tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索、抓取并交互网页内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网页获取结构化数据或进行实时搜索。
copy.tagline_en: Search, scrape, and interact with web content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract structured data from websites or perform real-time web searches.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Firecrawl 命令行工具上网搜索、抓取网页、爬取整站等,与需要点击或登录的页面交互,还能设置监控盯着页面变化,结果整理成适合阅读的 Markdown。
howto.when: 当你想搜索或研究网页内容、抓取某个网址、爬取网站文档,或与需要点击、填表、登录的网页交互时触发;你说「fetch this page」这类话也会触发。本地文件、git、部署等任务不触发。

say.text: 帮我在网上搜索最新的AI行业动态
say.note: 会调用搜索并返回整理好的结果
会抓取该页面并输出干净的 Markdown

say.text: 帮我盯着这个商品页面,价格变了就提醒我
say.note: 会为该页面创建定时监控任务

howto.what_en: With this installed, Claude uses the Firecrawl CLI to search the web, scrape pages, crawl sites, or interact with pages needing clicks or logins, returning results as clean markdown suited for LLM context windows.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to search the web, scrape a URL, crawl a site, or interact with pages needing clicks or login (e.g. "fetch this page"). Not for local files, git, deployments, or code editing.

say_en.text: Search the web for the latest AI industry news.
say_en.note: Runs a search and returns top results.

say_en.text: Scrape the content of this URL: https://example.com
say_en.note: Fetches the page and outputs clean markdown.

say_en.text: Watch this product page and alert me when the price changes.
say_en.note: Sets up a recurring monitor for the page.
